alt_text: Two students sit at wooden desks in a classroom with a green chalkboard, a wall clock, and a wooden floor, with warm light falling across the room. in Polanco, Mexico City. Text on the image: False friends: words that look Spanish but aren't
caption:
False friends: words that look Spanish but aren't. • embarazada ≠ embarrassed (pregnant)
• actually ≠ actualmente (in fact)
• library ≠ librería (biblioteca)
• assist ≠ asistir (help)
